title: Settings of the HTTP destination (what it adds to the shared client)
description: The settings of the HTTP destination (T-04.5) are the settings of the shared HTTP client (http_client.schema.json: url, method, timeout, compression, TLS verification, authentication and the retry policy) followed by the ones below. The names are for ONE HTTP destination. The library reads no file and no environment (ADR-004). The order of the problems is that of http_client.schema.json and then of this one.

minimum_severity.description: The lowest severity that is sent: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO (the default), WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL. An event below it is not sent.
